newsitem.title: KENYA: Commercial bank pushes down Nairobi bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Commercial bank pushes down Nairobi bourse index.

text.p: Falling shares of Kenya Commercial Bank on Thursday pushed down the Nairobi Stock Exchange's 20-share index in a bearish market, bourse officials said.
The index lost 13.19 points to close at 3402.21. Turnover was 26.951 million shillings on 412,466 shares compared to 44.183 million shillings on 1,084,366 shares on Wednesday.
Kenya Commercial Bank shed four to close at 93.
Brokers said the drop in the price was temporary as the rising price seen since the public share offer in October, was driven by demand -- mostly from foreigners.

"The major problem is that a lot of the local investors are driven by dividend and bonus in the purchase decisions," a senior broker said. "And now that the bank's management were conservative in their dividend policy, a lot of them thought the price would fall," he added.

They said the majority of local investors had gambled on the fact that if the bank gave a bonus issue of one share for three shares and a total dividend of six shillings in the previous year, this year would be better with an improved performance.
"But what they do not understand is the current share price is supported by solid demand for the share, not speculation over year-end results," another broker said.
He added the bank's shareholders portfolio had changed with the entry of foreign investors in 1996 and these were unlikely to change their long-term investment policy in the bank share.
Barclays Bank was unchanged at 111 while Diamond Trust Bank Kenya eased to 32 from 32.25.
Standard Chartered Bank closed at 46.50 unchanged, while Total Kenya traded at 62.50 from 67.
The plantations Rea Vipingo Plantations was unchanged at 10 while Sasini Tea & Coffee traded at 75 unchanged.
National carrier Kenya Airways closed at 8.60 from 8.70 while Uchumi Supermarket was unchanged at 40.
